title: Crematory Operators
description: Operate crematory equipment to reduce human or animal remains to bone fragments in accordance with state and local regulations. Duties may include preparing the body for cremation and performing general maintenance on crematory equipment. May use traditional flame-based cremation, calcination, or alkaline hydrolysis.

tasks.text: Clean the crematorium, including tables, floors, and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of facilities and work areas

tasks.text: Document divided remains to ensure parts are not misplaced.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain files and records in structured systems

dwas.name: Maintain records, documents, or other files.

tasks.text: Embalm, dress, or otherwise prepare the deceased for viewing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying agents to hair and skin is hands-on care

dwas.name: Apply cleansing or conditioning agents to client hair, scalp, or skin.
Apply makeup to alter or enhance appearance.

tasks.text: Explain the cremation process to family or friends of the deceased.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — AI can script; live explanation and trust are human

dwas.name: Explain use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

dwas.name: Discuss goods or services information with customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Offer counsel and comfort to bereaved families or friends.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Comfort and encouragement need live emotional presence

dwas.name: Provide counsel, comfort, or encouragement to individuals or families.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Pick up and handle human or pet remains in a respectful manner.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical transport of biological materials

dwas.name: Transport biological or other medical materials.

tasks.text: Place corpses into crematory machines to reduce remains to bone fragments using flame, heat, or alkaline hydrolysis.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Load materials into equipment for processing.
Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Pulverize remaining bone fragments into smaller pieces, using specialized equipment, such as a cremulator or grinder.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

tasks.text: Read documentation to confirm the identity of the deceased.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Spec verification against references, human confirms edge cases

tasks.text: Remove jewelry, watches, or other personal items from the deceased prior to cremation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical preparation of patients

dwas.name: Prepare patients physically for medical procedures.

tasks.text: Sweep or vacuum the cremation chamber to retrieve remains for storage in an urn or other container.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of facilities and equipment

tasks.text: Transport the deceased to a funeral home or crematory using a van, hearse, or other vehicle.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving vehicles to transport people/equipment

dwas.name: Drive vehicles to transport individuals or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment
